title: Havells Tango Wireless Digital Doorbell (White & Red), 25 Chime Melodies, 3 Volume Levels, 100m 433.92MHz Open Air Receiver and Transmitter Range, Loved by Users for LED Stylish and Superb Longevity
description: Weather-resistant Transmitter: Built to withstand any weather, the transmitter of this digital doorbell is just as dependable in the rain, sun, or freezing weather. Its durable construction ensures years of use. Battery-powered Convenience: Goodbye to the wiring hassle with a completely battery-powered system. Digital receiver and transmitter of this doorbell are both powered by batteries, offering true wireless convenience and easy installation wherever you wish—no electrician or drilling required. Digital Receiver: With intelligent digital technology, the receiver gets an instant response to the signal of the transmitter. With every button press, you get a distinct and prompt chime, so you never miss the guests, no matter how far away you are from the door. 100 m Range: Because of its strong signal range of up to 100 meters in open air, the doorbell is very flexible. Mount it in big houses, gardens, or offices without having to worry about connectivity and time delays. 25 Ringtone Choices: Choose from 25 built-in ringtones that match your mood or your personality. From a classic chime, a happy tune, there's a song for every individual and venue. 3 Volume Settings: Choose from low, medium, or high volume settings to suit your style or venue. From libraries that are quiet to busy neighborhoods, set the sound so that it's always heard without being intrusive. Simple Installation: With its minimalist design, the doorbell is a breeze and lightweight to install. Simply stick or screw it wherever you prefer. Perfect for rented flats, apartments, or easy replacements with minimal setup. Remote Control Convenience: Experience the convenience of remote control of your doorbell. With ease, simply use the wireless remote control to activate the chime without having to touch the transmitter, providing increased convenience, particularly for the elderly or people with mobility issues.
